name: medicament
description: A commercial medicine or brand name found in a source.

name: active_ingredient
description: A medicine's active substance, usually identified by its DCI.

name: therapeutic_class
description: A therapeutic class recorded in the nomenclature.

name: indication
description: A condition or symptom a source says a medicine is used for.

name: adverse_effect
description: An unwanted effect reported by a source.

name: contraindication
description: A condition or situation in which a source says a medicine must not be used.

name: literal
description: A text value such as a strength or dosage form.

name: brand_of
description: A commercial medicine name associated with an active ingredient.

name: has_ATC
description: The ATC code listed for an active ingredient.

name: belongs_to
description: The therapeutic class listed for an active ingredient.

name: has_strength
description: The strength listed for an active ingredient in the nomenclature; not brand-specific.

name: has_form
description: The form listed for an active ingredient in the nomenclature; not brand-specific.

name: indicated_for
description: An indication stated by a source.

name: may_cause
description: An adverse effect stated by a source.

name: contraindicated_in
description: A contraindication stated by a source.

name: interacts_with
description: An interaction stated between active ingredients.
